$description: SYNTHETIC token store (DTCG / W3C Design Tokens format). Replaced on the agency machine by real Figma variables via Dev Mode MCP. Named by intent, not implementation; every token carries a 'when to use'. GTB-flavoured values for realism.

primary.$description: Primary CTA / single decisive action. Accent only — never a page background.
